title: Audit events the contract tests may assert, contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d4)
description: Event list [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L148-161; LD §8 L417-427]. Envelope names [SRC: AUD §7A.4]; login-specific mapping [SRC: LD §8 L424]. Tenant fields are in the nested scope.* envelope (scope.partner_id, scope.cachd_client_id, scope.location_ids) per AUD §7A.4, with scope.client_id renamed scope.cachd_client_id [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23, OQ-37] (LD §16.19 row 114 L701, §16.19.4 L1443). Tokens stay flat (claims.schema.json).

category.description: Events category [SRC: LD §8 L413]. Literal 'event' [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23].

event_type.description: auth.* names only; iam.permission.change_requested renamed auth.provider.change_requested [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-38] (LD §8 L427, row 115 L702).

user_id.description: = sub; null when the user is unknown (failed sign-in) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

source.description: service, versions [SRC: AUD §7A.4]; ip, user_agent [SRC: LD L417, L424].

outcome.description: success / failure / denied [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23/OQ-24]; success and denied appear in LD L424, L426.

x_standin.description: Stand-in events only; the audit relay/ingest outside Development rejects and alerts on any event carrying it [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25].

scope.description: Tenant scope [SRC: AUD §7A.4] [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-37]. cachd_client_id absent for partner-level users; location_ids absent for /admin [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15], or [] for an /admin event where no location applies; any other event needs ≥1 item [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM].

cachd_client_id.description: The Cachd client (casino operator), not the OAuth client [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-23, OQ-37].

location_ids.description: Array: one event can cover several locations (AUD §7A.4 L266, multi-location for admin actions); a session/token carries the single location_id; for a one-session event = [location_id] (contract 8.11) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].

admin_type.description: Present only on events from an /admin session; copied from the token's admin_type. Its presence is the switch that allows scope.location_ids: [] [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM]. Not yet in AUD §7A.4: open item AUD v0.8 [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:31 PM].

allOf.description: Without admin_type: scope.location_ids required, ≥1 item [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:29 PM; TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:31 PM]

auth.login.succeeded.description: [SRC: LD §8 L417]. Optional detail attestation [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-11] (TL Rec to the SA for LD §8 L417).

attestation.description: Plain sign-in attestation result; optional [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-11]. Never makes the session 'attested'.

auth.login.failed.description: [SRC: LD §8 L418; PLAN L150]. Never the password.

username_hmac.description: Lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 with a secret key over the normalized username (trim, Unicode NFKC, lowercase invariant) [SRC: LD L418; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. Stand-in key is test-only.

reason.description: Known codes: remote_session [SRC: LD L418]; locked, mfa_missing, tenant_mismatch, stale_auth_time [SRC: PLAN L146]; bad_credentials covers both unknown user and wrong password (no existence oracle), outbox_unavailable [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24] (LD §16.19.5); no password_expired reason [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24]. rate_limited is not an outbox reason (LD §8 L431). Full list per LD §16.19.5 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

auth.account.locked.description: [SRC: LD §8 L419]; 10 tries / 30 min [SRC: PLAN L34].

auth.account.unlocked.description: Who unlocked, user unlocked, identity check used [SRC: LD §8 L419].

auth.session.revoked.description: reason, actor [SRC: LD §8 L423]. One per login session ended, not per client/token [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-10]. reason=user_disabled when refresh finds the user disabled or locked [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-12]. Other values [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

auth.app.signed_in.description: [SRC: LD §8 L424; PLAN L156, S1 check 2]. One per code issued.

allOf.description: No app sign-in from a recovery_reenroll session (amr exactly [pwd]) [Confirmed DEC-085].

auth.app_access.denied.description: [SRC: LD §8 L426; PLAN §1.2 L51, L157, S1 checks 1, 4, 4a].

reason.description: notfromhub: rule 4, hub_launch missing or used [SRC: LD L426, L1186; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-7]. not_location_user: an /admin session (admin_type super or partner) asked for the Cash Advance hand-off [Confirmed DEC-084]. recovery_session: a recovery_reenroll session (recovery-code sign-in, amr [pwd]) asked for the hand-off, an app launch or hub_launch [Confirmed DEC-085].

auth.password.reset.description: Defined, not emitted in S1 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-26]. [SRC: LD §8 L421]. Channel values email | admin [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-24].

auth.provider.changed.description: Defined, not emitted in S1 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-26]. [SRC: LD §8 L422]. before/after never hold secrets.

not_emitted_fields_not_stated.description: Defined, not emitted in S1 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-26]. In LD §8 L427 with no fields stated (envelope only) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25]. Partner Admin method change = auth.provider.change_requested [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-38].

fields_not_stated.description: In the list [SRC: PLAN L158-160; LD §8 L427] but no fields are stated anywhere. Envelope only until the SA states fields [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-25].
